record.question: The full form of ASEAN is
options: Association of South East Asian Nations
Association of South Eastern Asian Nations
Association of South East Asia Nations
Association of South East Asian Nation
record.explanation: Answer A: Association of South East Asian Nations. ASEAN names itself Association of Southeast Asian Nations. Option A’s South East spacing is equivalent; the other choices alter Asian or plural Nations. Historical/source note: Only the stable name is used, not the present number of members. Reference: https://asean.org/about-asean/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
